title: chore(pm): governed approvers are os-zhuang alone (hotlong removed)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9MvxuzfDMfyAL28bsgrUsox)_

Fixes #34626

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：受管改动的批准账号从 os-zhuang 加 hotlong 两个，减成只有 os-zhuang。改在批准账号常量、它在 ui/ 下的副本、CODEOWNERS，以及跟着两人写死的自测。
- **为什么改**：你 2026-11-17 在分诊会话里的原话「hotlong 从批准账户中去掉，只保留 os-zhuang」。hotlong 在跑席位，而批准账号不能跑席位。
- **风险与回滚**：落地后 hotlong 的批准、入队都不再放行受管 PR，hotlong 账号写在 GitHub 上的评论也不再被工具当作维护者亲笔或可信记录。现在开着的 PR 里没有一个只靠 hotlong 批准。回滚就是 revert 本 PR。
- **先看**：`scripts/pm/check-governed-queue-guard.mjs`（常量和新裁决说明）、`.github/CODEOWNERS`、`scripts/pm/fleet-write/execute.mjs`（中继的自测注入口）。
- **两分钟验证**：`node scripts/pm/check-governed-queue-guard.mjs --self-test`，预期 581+ 例全过，其中一例写明「只有 hotlong 批准的 head 读作未批准」。
- **需要你做的**：用 os-zhuang 批准本 PR（受管面，Tier H），席位随后落地。

## What changes

The maintainer's order, given in the triage session on 2026-11-17 at about 03:50Z, verbatim: 「hotlong 从批准账户中去掉，只保留 os-zhuang」. It supersedes the membership of the 2026-08-27 set (「os-zhuang hotlong 批准算数」); every docblock that quoted that ruling keeps it as history, marked superseded, and cites the new one with its date.

- `scripts/pm/check-governed-queue-guard.mjs`: `GOVERNED_APPROVERS` is `['os-zhuang']`. The header gains a fourth dated layer (2026-11-17), the 2026-08-27 and 2026-10-26 passages say which half the new order superseded, and the two rendered remedy lines that named the old set now name the new one. Self-test: the membership pin is the one account; new cases pin that a head approved only by `hotlong` reads unapproved, that an enqueue by `hotlong` reads unauthorized, and that `hotlong` is not in the set. Cases that used `hotlong` as an authorized login, or indexed `GOVERNED_APPROVERS[1]`, use `os-zhuang` (the CODEOWNERS mirror's negative cases use the removed login as the wrong owner).
- `scripts/pm/check-governed-merges.mjs`: the weekly-audit N10 cases read the approver list through `loadAuditRulingAccounts()` (the guard's constant, as the job loads it) instead of a second literal `['os-zhuang', 'hotlong']`, with a pin that it equals `os-zhuang`; a hand close by `hotlong` is pinned as ruling nothing. Cases that used `hotlong` as the authorizing login use `os-zhuang`.
- `ui/scripts/check-governed-queue-guard.mjs`: the ui copy of `GOVERNED_APPROVERS` moves with the root one, its docblock records the 2026-11-17 order, and its self-test pins the one account and refuses a `hotlong`-only approval. Each copy has its own pin to the ruling, so neither can drift silently.
- `.github/CODEOWNERS`: every governed row names `@os-zhuang` only; the header records the new order with its date and keeps the old one and the old `hotlong` verification as history.
- `scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs` (overlap-check against open #34110: clean): the two comments that named the pair now read the 2026-11-17 set, and the H43 fixture `APP43` is marked as an injected two-account set, not the live roster.

### Forced test changes (named)

- `scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs`, case `H43 register: the imported matcher answers governed and clear, and the approver set is non-empty`: it asserted `approvers.length >= 2`; it now asserts a non-empty set, which is what its title says.
- `scripts/pm/fleet-write/execute.mjs`, battery `the governed-review follow-up`: 16 cases destructured `const [A1, A2] = GOVERNED_APPROVERS` and went red with one account. The relay's follow-up gains an `approvers` deps seam (default `GOVERNED_APPROVERS`; no behaviour change for the relay), and the battery runs against an injected pair whose first member is the live constant's first account, so the two-account union and the author-identity branch stay exercised. Two new cases pin the live wiring with nothing injected: the plan and an end-to-end `pr_ready` request `os-zhuang` alone.

## Acceptance notes

- **Who else reads the constant.** `GOVERNED_APPROVERS` is also the trusted-author half of `recordTrustedAuthors` (records read by the queue guard, `check-owed-reviews`, `label-write`, the H43 hand-off), the mailbox knock authors (`readMailboxComment`) and the audit's ruling closes. From this merge a comment or close authored by `hotlong` on GitHub is no longer read as the maintainer's or as a trusted record. Records a seat writes through the relay (`objectstack-fleet[bot]`) are unaffected. Records `hotlong` writes directly are not: for example the `Claim:` on #34659 (comment 6939887560, authored by `hotlong` on 2026-11-17T05:47Z) is a direct write, and from this merge only a record written through the relay counts; a `hotlong`-authored one is no longer trusted, consistent with #33541. The importers' self-tests pass unchanged.
- **In-flight governed PRs.** Measured 2026-11-17 ~05:40Z with the search API: no open PR in this repository carries a review by `hotlong` (`reviewed-by:hotlong` → 0), so no head loses its only approval. Four open PRs still list `hotlong` as a requested reviewer: #34612, #34600 (which requested both `os-zhuang` and `hotlong`), #34524 and the Version Packages PR #33849. A pending request does not count for anything; after this lands, only an `os-zhuang` approval lands them. The seat re-reads this list at merge time.
- **Seats running as `hotlong`** (triage#1, repo:cloud#5, the local coordinator) become compliant with the account rule that an approver never runs a seat. No seat change is needed.
- **#33011** (named on the card as "one open PR has a `hotlong` review") is an open p3 issue in this repository, not a pull request, and carries no review. No PR with that number exists to list.
- Follow-up: #34680 (the second `GOVERNED_APPROVERS` table in `ui/scripts/check-governed-queue-guard.mjs`; this PR only aligns its value).
- Not touched: `scripts/pm/check-governed-merges.mjs:1049` (a dated reading, `merged_by: hotlong`), `check-prior-rulings.mjs` and `fleet-roster.mjs` fixtures, and ADR-0130's evidence line. They record history or use the login as plain data, not as an approver.

## Verification

Head `fd6c64c745b2d22d5ec0145a53f2dd390a9f0134` (main e5336512f merged in).
